_about: Provenance of every reconstructed value, keyed by file and then by JSON pointer. 'first-party' = stated by OpenAI (technical report page numbers, or its incident page). 'secondary' = a third-party account. 'forced-choice' = the sources record no value, but a filing would have had to state one. 'placeholder' = not public; the value exists only so the record validates and must never be used in a predicate.

_case_wide.filer: placeholder: OpenAI did not file DBYR records; these are reconstructions from public sources
_case_wide.unit_of_filing: forced-choice: two training runs (A from 7 May, B from 11 Jun), each with a closeout, and one ExploitGym evaluation intent and closeout (C) covering the evaluation runs from 26 Jun; TR pp. 6-8
_case_wide.disputed: SW says OpenAI deleted the board messages on 4 Jul; TR p. 8 says the proxy was taken offline with its storage preserved. TR is followed.
_case_wide.run_attribution: forced-choice: TR places the May events and the 12 and 17 Jun events in training without naming the run; they are attributed to A and B by date window. One 19 Jul event (E21) came from a different model's evaluation run (TR p. 14) and is recorded under C.
